review.note: Merged in M44b into second-boer-war. Q1676845 is the series of two wars, but the record the import wrote from it starts on 11 October 1899 and ends in 1899, which is the second war and not the series: in this atlas it was indistinguishable from the record already held. Merged rather than kept and edged to its twin; it keeps the item. The first Boer war is not here and is not what this record was. The full account is in docs/m44-retractions.md.
